axilla-12.title: Normal axillary node with a preserved fatty hilum
axilla-12.label: Normal axillary node, oval profile
axilla-12.credit: Jung Min Chang et al., NAUTILUS protocol, Fig. 1B
axilla-12.reason: The oval node has a thin cortex around an echogenic fatty hilum.
axilla-12.note: The trial protocol calls panel B a representative normal axillary node. The image shows an elongated oval profile. Exact acquisition plane, laterality, and subject history are unreported. The original white vertical scale bar represents 1 cm. Cropped to panel B and converted to lossless WebP without resizing. Noncommercial reuse only.

axilla-48.title: Level I axilla in short axis, regional landmarks
axilla-48.label: Axilla in short axis, regional landmarks
axilla-48.credit: Michelle Fenech et al., Fig. 7B, middle sonogram
axilla-48.reason: The axillary artery and vein are shown in cross-section between muscle landmarks.
axilla-48.note: Regional comparison in the arm-crease window. The publication defines short axis relative to the axillary vessels. There is no identified lymph node in this panel, and the source does not specify patient laterality. The original posterior/lateral and anterior/medial image labels remain. Only the middle ultrasound panel was cropped and converted to lossless WebP without resizing.
